decisions.reason: Exact target is predeclared for edit and for both read and write
No implicit edit permission from generic report ownership
Read authority never grants a write
Edit also needs its explicit target read authority
Missing structured target is not inferred from opaque patch text
No dot-segment or alternate spelling expands the target list
Remote or internal URIs do not become filesystem edit targets
Every recorded adapter read or write remains separately scoped

scope: Declared audit authority for structured target metadata only; no native prevention, opaque patch interpretation, effect or reading proof.
